items.text: [p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Get ready to hit the tracks around Hawaii in The Crew Motorfest with our latest update! This Season 11 patch brings with it new TrackForge kit, vehicle adjustments, challenge fixes, and much, much, more!
[p align="start"]Keep on reading to find out more!

[p align="start"]\ The Crew Motorfest is releasing on Nintendo Switch 2 on October 8th, 2026, check out the full FAQ article coming later today here.
[p align="start"]\ A new Year Pass is available: Year Pass 4

[p align="start"]\ 2 new Playlists are available: Kaua'i Expeditions & Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni'ihau (Year Pass 4 or standalone DLC is required to access Tomb Raider playlist) ⁃ \ A new Trackforge Kit - Available to create & play around in new Off-Road environments: Pure Dirt
[p align="start"]\ Wildlife can now be spotted, roaming across all islands!
[p align="start"]\ RAINBOWS can now be seen across the world! Hawaii finally earns its “Rainbow State” name. Some say that DOUBLE rainbows might even appear to the luckiest ones…

[p align="start"]\ New feature: the Winch! - A selection of vehicles can now attach to hard surfaces & contextual vehicles and objects! Things are getting REEL! (Please laugh this is a good joke) Note: you can identify eligible vehicles through the "filter" option
[p align="start"]\ New gameplay Camera: The Exploration Camera can now be used throughout the game on all ground vehicles, providing you with a broader view of the world!
[p align="start"]\ New vehicle type: Seaplane! Approach aerial & naval navigation from a new angle! Available in the Plane vehicle category (Included in Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni'ihau DLC)

[p align="start"]\ New vehicle type: 6-Wheeler! Conquer all terrain with dedicated 6-wheel physics on the Mercedez-Benz G 63 AMG 6x6. Available in the Rally Raid vehicle category (Included in Tomb Raider: Secrets of Ni'ihau DLC)

items.text: [p align="start"]Ready your engines and give your creativity free reign with The Crew Motorfest's newest update! items.text: Get ready to hit the roads of The Crew Motorfest with our latest update! This patch brings a host of new music, gameplay improvements, vehicle handling adjustments, and quality-of-life fixes across the game.

As we gear up for the launch of Season 7 in The Crew Motorfest, we’re excited to share a range of quality-of-life improvements designed to enhance your time behind the wheel. From refinements in core gameplay systems to fixes inspired directly by community feedback, this update focuses on making your Motorfest experience smoother, more intuitive, and more rewarding.

Fast Fav Update: The Fast Fav system has been updated with more flexibility, you now have 4 customizable slots instead of 3, and you’re no longer limited to one vehicle per terrain type. Choose and assign any vehicle you want, regardless of category, for a setup that matches your style.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44945751/24f7453d46363fe050eb0a2e5cda9fa4b364d5fe.jpg"]

Recommended Vehicles Section: A new Recommended section has been added to the shop, making it easier to discover vehicles curated for your preferences. For now, this section is focused exclusively on vehicles.

New Immersive Mode: Brand new in Season 7, Immersive Mode lets you cruise through the island with no UI elements on screen, perfect for players who want a cinematic, distraction-free driving experience.
Essential UI elements will remain in place where necessary.
New Batch of Dynamic Races: A fresh rotation of Dynamic Races has been added across the island, bringing new challenges and variety to your free-roam sessions.
Jet Affixes Fix: Bugs related to jet vehicle affixes have been resolved to ensure consistent performance and fairness.
Split Time Functionality: Keep track of your performance more precisely during Grand Races with the new split time indicators, allowing for more competitive and strategic racing.
Spectator Mode: Dive into the action from a new perspective. Whether you're watching friends race or studying your competition, Spectator Mode brings a whole new layer of immersion.
Season 7 introduces new ways to experience Grand Races with two gameplay modifiers now being added to the mix:

Pro Racing Modifier in Grand Race: While the Pro Racing modifier itself isn’t new—it enforces a more immersive view by locking players to cockpit camera, disabling the mini map, and more it will now occasionally appear within Grand Race events for the first time. This brings a new level of challenge and realism to some of the game’s most competitive tracks.

Alpha Jet Modifier in Grand Race: This brand-new modifier introduces Alpha Jet segments into Grand Races, blending high-speed racing with aerial sections. Its inclusion in the Grand Race format adds a fresh twist and keeps racers on their toes.

Revamped Main Stage Challenges: Starting with Season 7, the weekly Main Stage challenges are getting a much-needed refresh. Instead of repeating the same objectives week after week, the challenges will now rotate and evolve to match the theme of each week, bringing more variety and giving players new goals to chase throughout the season.
Feat Restrictions Now Playable in Crew: You can now complete Summit Feats with your crew even when certain restrictions are in place—perfect for tackling challenges together.

Summit Sequential Modifier: A new gameplay twist that will appear in select Summit events this modifier forces manual gear shifting, offering a greater challenge for those looking to prove their driving skills. This won’t be active every week, but when it is, get ready to take full control.
New Weather Options: Photo and Custom Event Mode now support new weather presets—perfect for those dramatic, atmospheric shots.
Custom Show Voting Update: The voting rules in Custom Show have been adjusted. These changes aim to ensure a more balanced and rewarding competition experience.

These changes are all part of our ongoing commitment to making The Crew Motorfest the best playground for car culture fans around the world. We’re thankful for your feedback and can’t wait for you to experience these updates for yourself in Season 7.
See you on the Islands!

releases.displayName: The Crew Motorfest Season 4 Patch Notes

items.text: Season 4 of The Crew Motorfest just released and with it comes a variety of new patch notes! Our latest patch introduces some quality-of-life updates to the game - like more customization options, improvements to Summit and the Custom Show!
We've put together this non-exhaustive list of the changes to come in these patch notes. You can also check out our Season 4 Quality of Life Article to learn more about our decisions.
For a more detailed breakdown of the content released in Season 4 please refer to the Content Overview.
Please follow our official channels for any additional updates.
PC: 35.41 GB
PlayStation 4: 6.658 GB
PlayStation 5: 6.466 GB
Xbox One: 8.126 GB
Xbox Series: 10.315 GB
Patch sizes may vary based on your game version.
Playlist: Donk vs Lowrider: Get ready for an epic dive into two iconic car styles!
Playlist: Off Roading Addict Vol.2: available on August 14th
Difficulty Setting Reminder: We've added a reminder to the Playlist content menu and Summit menu.
Joy & Excitement: AI does not get stuck anymore!
Hanauma Waters Event: AI drivers are now better behaved.
Motorsport Prologue: Fixed instances where some AI cars would go off track after using the rewind feature at the start of the Motorsport Prologue.

Navigation event exploitation: We've fixed the issue where navigation events could be exploited by creating them in checkpoints. Since this is a completely new behavior, we'll reset the leaderboard for such an event during the July 3 maintenance.
Raptor X Delicacy Event: Corrected the time format for best lap times in this event.
Scene 7: The Love Story: The rewards are back to their original values.
Tallahassee Melee Event: Rally Cars can now be selected in Custom Mode.
Dynamic Suspension: Experience this new feature for Low Riders during Free Roam by activating it with the following controls:
Xbox: Press B to engage the Dynamic Suspension System.
PlayStation: Press circle to activate the Dynamic Suspension System.
Press the same button again to toggle between three modes:
Regular: Standard suspension behavior.
All Directions: Allows dynamic movement in all directions.
Lock: Locks the suspension in place.
Mouse controls now work when using the filter options in the shop.
Fixed a crash with the latest version of the Logitech GHUB.
It is now possible to set new key bindings from the Wheel and Accessories menu.
PS4: Hori Racing Wheel Apex now works as intended.
Completed Side Activity Status: The status for completed side activities now appears in green on the progress meter of any playlist
Vehicle Collection Thumbnails: We've optimized loading times for vehicle thumbnails in the Vehicle Collection. Now you can browse your cars more efficiently.
Horizontal Vehicle Sorting: Vehicles are now sorted horizontally based on their level.
The main stage title reward text no longer overlaps the image in large text settings.
Crew members' weather icons in cinematics will now display correctly after adjusting the weather settings in any event. Stay informed!
Fixed the missing yellow dot icon that indicates a new upgrade is available for a vehicle. Keep your rides up to date!
Added an "Engine Type" sorting option for filtering vehicles. Customize your collection your way.
Summit points text no longer overflows.
Dashboard Figures & Glass Hangers: Earn these new vanities as rewards throughout the game. Customize your dashboard and add some flair to your ride!
Adjustable Rim Size: You can now update rim size on several vehicles that had this option available in The Crew 2.
Livery Material Modification: You can now edit the "modify material" tab for liveries using the D-pad.
We've fine-tuned the movement of several rooftop vanities.
When zooming in on classic vehicles in the customization menu, liveries will no longer get distorted. Enjoy a clear view of your artwork.
Fixed occurrences where liveries could be applied without player validation. Now your custom designs will be properly authorized.
All Monster Truck vehicles now handle better while driving in reverse.
Resolved graphical corruptions occurring on different vehicle parts and models.
Mileage info will no longer reset to 0 on affected cars.
Livery display issues on several vehicles.
Elegant Gold Tire Vanity behaves correctly even at speeds over 10 km/h.
Liveries that couldn't be applied on certain vehicles can now be applied as intended.
Certain horn previews no longer overlap with previous horn sounds.
We've added the missing iridescent paint option to several vehicles in the customization menu.
Camera issues and placement on planes have been addressed.
Fixed interior and dashboard issues on several vehicles.
Retro Alarm Horn vanity now plays a proper preview sound.
Vehicle color display is now accurate when purchasing a bundle of vehicles.
Bugatti Centodieci: Top side liveries no longer impact side skirt #2.
Creators YasidDESIGN X American Petrol: Rooftop vanities no longer clip into the vehicle.
Ford F-150 SVT Raptor: Supercharger hood visuals no longer clip incorrectly.
Gordon Murray Automotive T.50: Rim colors have been corrected.
Koenigsegg Agera R: Left side liveries no longer apply to the right front side of the bumper.
KTM X-Bow GTX: Front bumpers no longer suffer from texture clipping.
Maserati Ghibli: Now has the right name.
Mutsibishi 3000GT VR4 Interception Unit: Rooftop vanities are now correctly placed.
Porsche 718 SPYDER FITTED Edition: Now has the right name.
Shelby Cobra 427: Side windows of rear fender #5 no longer clip into side mirrors.
Volkswagen Eletric R: Underglow projection is now properly aligned.
Weekly Challenges: Get ready for exciting weekly challenges on the Main Stage. Test your skills and reap the rewards!
Summit Event Difficulty: Adjust AI difficulty directly from the pause menu during a Summit Event. Fine-tune your challenge level on the fly.
Gameplay modifiers are now factored into Summit points calculations, and the reward flow reflects this change.
We've fixed issues with the display of rewards on the Main Stage display board in the Car Meet.
The Mainstage Pitstop Pressure reward will now display correctly in the Car Meet area.
Previously registered cars will no longer remain in the registration spot during a new Custom Show Rotation.
Leaderboards Addition: Get ready for some more competition! We've added leaderboards for the Main Stage legacy events. See how you stack up against other players.
Crew members' rankings now update correctly during LAP events in the American Main Stage.
Events that require a specific vehicle won't fail to validate if only the crew leader possesses that vehicle.
AFK crew members won't mistakenly appear in the 1st rank during Main Stage events.
We've fixed instances where events from the Main Stage had incorrect descriptions.
Podium and reward movie cinematics are no longer too dark after event completion.
Wrong cars won't haunt your event selection screen anymore. The correct vehicles will be displayed.
When aborting a Main Stage legacy event in a crew, the leaderboards text now displays correctly.
Fixed occurrences where wrong objectives were shown for events.
The racing line won't disappear prematurely at 90% during the SWIFT event in the Performance Showcase month.
Vehicle Category Previews Before entering a Grand Race, you can now preview the available vehicle categories from the dedicated Activity Menu tile.
When the mini map is turned OFF in 'Game Settings,' it will now properly deactivate during Grand Race gameplay.
We've fixed the respawn position on several sections after using Back on Track in Grand Race.
Off-road sections where the V-Cat was set to Racing have been corrected.
We've increased slipstream intensity in Demolition Royale, making catchups easier.
Destroying opponents now grants the correct amount of max life in Demolition Royale.
Other players' planes won't appear transparent anymore.
Purchase Other Players' Vehicles: Buy other players' Custom Show registered vehicles directly from the Car Meet.
Improved Reward Flow: The Custom Show reward flow has been fine-tuned. Get your rewards smoothly!
Vehicle Snapshot Display: During the Custom Show reward flow, a snapshot of your vehicle is now shown.
Custom Show Menu Interface: Accessible from the Activity menu, the Custom Show interface now displays a calendar and leaderboards.
We've changed the avatar spawn location in the Car Meet.
You can now use a personal livery from the "shared" category to register a vehicle for the Custom Show.
Previously registered vehicles won't linger when the Custom Show has ended.
Reduced camera movement when entering the Custom Show for the first time from the activity menu.
